# File Uploads and Downloads

## Upload a local file

~~~php
use Amirxd\UltraTelegram\Input\InputFile;

$bot->sendDocument([
    'chat_id' => 123456789,
    'document' => InputFile::fromPath(__DIR__ . '/report.pdf')
]);
~~~

## Upload generated content

~~~php
$file = InputFile::fromContent(
    "Report generated by the bot\n",
    'report.txt',
    'text/plain'
);

$bot->sendDocument([
    'chat_id' => 123456789,
    'document' => $file
]);
~~~

## Nested media uploads

Files nested in arrays are converted to Telegram attach:// references and sent in one multipart request. This is useful for methods such as sendMediaGroup.

## Download files

~~~php
$bot->downloadFile(
    'TELEGRAM_FILE_ID',
    __DIR__ . '/downloads/document.pdf'
);
~~~

You can also use a known file_path:

~~~php
$bot->downloadFilePath(
    'documents/document.pdf',
    __DIR__ . '/downloads/document.pdf'
);
~~~

Existing destination files are not overwritten unless overwrite is explicitly set to true. The default transport uses the Ultra Request streaming Downloader and disables redirects for token-bearing download URLs.
